```
Manage SSH keys for authentication.

User SSH Keys:
  Users can upload their own public SSH keys to their account. These keys
  are automatically added to all workspaces owned by the user.

Workspace SSH Keys:
  Each workspace has a unique Ed25519 key pair generated by the system.
  The private key can be downloaded to access the workspace directly.

Usage:
  spin ssh-key [flags]
  spin ssh-key [command]

Available Commands:
  add         Upload an SSH public key to your account
  delete      Delete an SSH key from your account
  get         Download the private SSH key for a workspace
  list        List your uploaded SSH public keys
  regenerate  Regenerate SSH key pair for a workspace

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for ssh-key

Global Flags:
      --config string    config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)
  -o, --output string    text for a person, or json: one document of what the API answered, and no prose (default "text")
      --profile string   named profile to use (default "default")

Use "spin ssh-key [command] --help" for more information about a command.
```

### spin ssh-key add

```
Upload an SSH public key that will be added to all your workspaces.

Examples:
  spin ssh-key add laptop ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
  spin ssh-key add work-key /path/to/key.pub
  spin ssh-key add mykey - < key.pub  # Read from stdin

Usage:
  spin ssh-key add <name> <public-key-file> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for add

Global Flags:
      --config string    config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)
  -o, --output string    text for a person, or json: one document of what the API answered, and no prose (default "text")
      --profile string   named profile to use (default "default")
```

### spin ssh-key get

```
Download the workspace's unique private SSH key.

Each workspace has a unique SSH key pair generated by the system.
This command downloads the private key to ~/.spin/keys/<workspace-id>.

spin ssh does not use this key: it signs a short-lived certificate for your own key
(~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa or id_ecdsa, or -i) each time it connects.

Examples:
  spin ssh-key get my-workspace
  spin ssh-key get my-workspace -o /path/to/key

Usage:
  spin ssh-key get <workspace> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for get
  -o, --output string   Output file path (default: ~/.spin/keys/<workspace-id>)

Global Flags:
      --config string    config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)
      --profile string   named profile to use (default "default")
```

### spin ssh-key regenerate

```
Regenerate the SSH key pair for a workspace.

WARNING: This will invalidate the current key. You will need to
download the new key to access the workspace.

Usage:
  spin ssh-key regenerate <workspace> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for regenerate
  -y, --yes    Skip confirmation

Global Flags:
      --config string    config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)

      --profile string   named profile to use (default "default")
```
